about_short_description.short_description: Lawn Love is an online lawn service and care provider.

product.name: Lawn Mowing Service
product.description: Provides regular or one-time lawn mowing to maintain grass at desired heights and neat appearance.

product.name: Yard Clean Up
product.description: Removal of debris, leaves, and other unwanted materials from yards to maintain cleanliness and lawn health.

product.name: Lawn Aeration
product.description: Creates small holes in the soil to improve air, water, and nutrient penetration to grass roots.

product.name: Lawn Fertilization
product.description: Application of nutrients to lawns to promote healthy growth, color, and resistance to stress.

product.name: Lawn Seeding and Overseeding
product.description: Spreading grass seed over existing lawns to repair bare spots and thicken turf.

product.name: Weed Control
product.description: Treatment to reduce or eliminate unwanted weeds in lawns and garden areas.
